The '''Doellinist Historical Archive''' was an archive located in the [[First Temple of Doellin]], the largest [[Doellinism/Legends|Doellin]] temple on [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. It contained writings and artwork from across Doellinism's long history.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
